run_update_bn_stats: run update_bn_stats to recompute batch norm statistics for a PyTorch model using a data loader
run_get_bn_modules: run get_bn_modules to find all BatchNorm modules in training mode within a PyTorch model
review_PopulationVarianceEstimator: review the _PopulationVarianceEstimator class that estimates population variance using batch-size-weighted sample variance
review_MeanOfBatchVarianceEstimator: review the _MeanOfBatchVarianceEstimator class that estimates population variance as a simple average of batch variances
review_BN_MODULE_TYPES: review the BN_MODULE_TYPES tuple that lists supported BatchNorm module types including BatchNorm1d, 2d, 3d, and SyncBatchNorm
